name: Trip Leg 4
definition: Supplies additional transaction information for travel transactions.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Identifies the specific occurrence of trip leg data.

TicketIssuer.name: Ticket Issuer
TicketIssuer.definition: Name of the issuing ticket agent.

ConjunctionTicketNumber.name: Conjunction Ticket Number
ConjunctionTicketNumber.definition: Number of a ticket that contains additional coupons for an itinerary that contains more than four segments.

RestrictedTicket.name: Restricted Ticket
RestrictedTicket.definition: Indicates whether or not restrictions apply to the ticket.||True = Restrictions apply|False = Restrictions do not apply

OpenTicket.name: Open Ticket
OpenTicket.definition: Indicates whether or not the ticket is open-ended. ||True = Ticket is open-ended|False = Ticket is not open-ended

TicketRestrictions.name: Ticket Restrictions
TicketRestrictions.definition: Contains the specific restriction applicable to the ticket.

ExchangedTicket.name: Exchanged Ticket
ExchangedTicket.definition: Indicates whether or not the ticket was exchanged (reissued or new ticket generated). ||True = Ticket was exchanged|False = Ticket was not exchanged

ExchangedTicketNumber.name: Exchanged Ticket Number
ExchangedTicketNumber.definition: Contains the original ticket number that was replaced by the new ticket number.

ReservationSystem.name: Reservation System
ReservationSystem.definition: Computerised reservation system used to make the reservation and purchase the ticket.

ReservationNumber.name: Reservation Number
ReservationNumber.definition: Value that uniquely identifies the reservation.

OriginalReservationSystem.name: Original Reservation System
OriginalReservationSystem.definition: System code that identifies the original reservation system used to make the reservation and purchase the ticket.

OriginalReservationNumber.name: Original Reservation Number
OriginalReservationNumber.definition: Value that identifies the original reservation generated during the original reservation and purchase of the ticket.

TransportType.name: Transport Type
TransportType.definition: Type of transportation. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

CommodityCode.name: Commodity Code
CommodityCode.definition: Provides the identifier assigned by the card acceptor that best categorizes the items being purchased in a standardized commodity group.

IATACode.name: IATA Code
IATACode.definition: Contains the International Air Transport Association (IATA) code identifying the company that purchased the ticket.

RouteNumber.name: Route Number
RouteNumber.definition: Route number as specified by the transportation carrier (for example, flight number, bus number, train route or number, etc.)

ServiceClass.name: Service Class
ServiceClass.definition: Indicates the service class (for example, coach or first class).

Departure.name: Departure
Departure.definition: Contains departure location, date and time.

Arrival.name: Arrival
Arrival.definition: Contains arrival location, date and time.

StopOver.name: Stop Over
StopOver.definition: Indicator that specifies whether the mode of transportation was a direct or non-direct route on the same ticket number.

NonDirectRouteCode.name: Non Direct Route Code
NonDirectRouteCode.definition: Indicates a non-direct route between the origin and the destination.

FairBasisCode.name: Fair Basis Code
FairBasisCode.definition: Code that transportation companies assign to a particular ticket type, such as business class or discounted or non-refundable tickets.

Insurance.name: Insurance
Insurance.definition: Indicates whether or not insurance was purchased.

CreditReasonCode.name: Credit Reason Code
CreditReasonCode.definition: Indicates reason for the credit to the cardholder.  Includes: ancillary purchase cancelled, passenger transport ticket and related ancillary purchase cancelled, etc.

ProcedureIdentification.name: Procedure Identification
ProcedureIdentification.definition: Contains identification of the rail server procedure or the order in which the service was booked or a cancellation was completed.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
